chapter: Irish Channel youth, newspapers and McDonogh 35
title: McDonogh 35 classmates and Thelma Brown
summary: He lists schoolmates and relatives who graduated from McDonogh 35, and remembers his sweetheart Thelma Brown.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: When you went to McDonough were you living across the river?
I was, that's when my mother moved back on the west bank of the river, right we were living in Gretna then we had moved out of the Irish Channel.
Who are some of your classmates that, because McDonough 35 has a lot of famous graduates over the years.

Oh let me see, my classmates, wow, oh my goodness, well Amos Morris he and I are still alive and we go to regular Baptist church. Reverend Daniel Powell, my pastor, he went to McDonough 35, he's a graduate of McDonough 35. My cousin, Theodora Carter, also Alga Carter, and Irma Carter, and Cleo Carter, all those are graduates of McDonough 35. The whole family just about graduated from McDonough 35. And let's see who else I could, people who not, not family members, like people like, what is Leo's last name? I just can't think, boy that's going back over the other side, over 50 years now. Jonas Monroe, Timothy LeCore, Oscar, Oscar Davis, I have a young man who, I'm trying to think of his name, who became Assistant District Attorney for Los Angeles California, I can't think of his name right now. Thomas Montgomery, who worked for the State Department, graduated from McDonough 35. G.C. Montgomery, graduated from McDonough 35. Elzena Simmons, graduated from McDonough 35. That was it, that I could think of right now. Timothy LeCore, he's graduated from McDonough 35. Thelma Brown, one of my first girlfriends and sweethearts, one of the prettiest girls to ever walk.

Thelma Brown. Thelma Brown. One of the prettiest black ladies to ever walk the streets of City North. And she just died here about a year or so ago, but you wouldn't believe that at her age she was in her late 60s, but she was still a pretty woman. I mean she was a beautiful woman with the prettiest lace you ever want to see.
